t.zh: <level-ref to="decl-eq"></level-ref>把相等声明进了证明核。也可以不声明，用量词定义它：「a = b」就是「a 有的性质，b 都有」，写成 ∀P. P(a) → P(b)。
t.en: <level-ref to="decl-eq"></level-ref> declared equality into the kernel. It can also be defined with a quantifier instead: “a = b” is “every property a has, b has”, written ∀P. P(a) → P(b).

t.zh: 这里的 ∀ 管的是性质：P(x) 是一句说 x 的话。<part-ref to="part:allI"></part-ref>取大写的 P。按这个定义，晨星 = 晨星 写出来就是这一关的目标。
t.en: This ∀ ranges over properties: P(x) is a sentence about x. The <part-ref to="part:allI"></part-ref> takes the upper-case P. By this definition, the Morning Star = the Morning Star is this level’s goal.

after.zh: 声明给出的自反律，在定义下是一条证出来的结论。
after.en: The reflexivity a declaration gives is, under the definition, a conclusion proved.

brief.zh: 不用任何已知，证明：对于任意性质，如果晨星具有该性质，那么晨星具有该性质。
brief.en: From nothing, prove: for every property, if the Morning Star has that property, then the Morning Star has it.

hint.zh: 任取框取的名字选 P：框里 P 是任意一种性质。
hint.en: Take the name P in the for-any box: inside, P is any property at all.

hint.zh: 框里是一个假设框：它的假设就是它要的结论。
hint.en: Inside goes an assumption box whose assumption is just the conclusion it wants.
